$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later. Expected I/O worked out from OpenRGB's C++ (commit d4798c120659ec5ba2e664a9e87bedff8d36f880, Controllers/AsusAuraUSBController: AsusAuraKeyboardController.cpp SendDirect, RGBController_AsusAuraKeyboard.cpp SetupZones / DeviceUpdateLEDs, AsusAuraTUFKeyboardController.cpp UpdateLeds / GetLayout / GetNumpadLocation / AllowRemoteControl / ClearResponses / AwaitResponse, RGBController_AsusAuraTUFKeyboard.cpp SetupZones / DeviceUpdateMode, layouts from AsusAuraTUFKeyboardLayouts.h) by a separate Python reference model (openrgb-work/batch2/asus/gen_keyboard.py in the porting session's scratch space, not part of the repository); plugin.js was never run to make them. ops: ['clear'] = ClearResponses (device.clearReadBuffer), ['write', hex] = 65-byte output report (hid_write, report id 0x00 first), ['read', length, timeout ms] = hid_read_timeout / hid_read. HueDeck deviations modelled here and described in docs/hardware/asus-aura-keyboard.md: blocking reads are bounded (layout / numpad probe 1000 ms, Scope TKL 'read to apply' 20 ms); GetVersion is not sent; the Claymore's layout number is OpenRGB's default (117) because HueDeck has no bcdDevice. reply_data: the data bytes (after the report id) the device answers the probe with. leds: the LED cells in OpenRGB's LED order; colours per LED in that order.
